info.description:
# B2B Platform admin (سوبر أدمن)

Generated **2026-11-03** from `route:list` + catalog. Live routes only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Requests | **181** |
| Environment | `docs/api/environments/platform-web.postman_environment.json` |
| X-Client | `platform-web` |
| Seed | admin@platform.sy / password — role platform_admin |

Import this file **and** the matching environment. `baseUrl` is the host only (no `/api/v1`).
Do not mix tokens across platform / channel / warehouse collections.

Contract briefs: `docs/DocsLast/platform.md` · order flow: `docs/DocsLast/order-flow.md`

Regenerate: `php docs/api/generate-dashboard-postman.php`
